verdicts.reason: A reads left to right as a banner should: the can sits inside its circle, then brand and headline, then copy with badges, then a large CTA at the right end. Its flaws are a small headline for the format and body copy and badges that compete for attention. B separates the can from its circle, leaving an empty circle cropped at the left edge, and puts the headline above the SOLSTICE wordmark. The CTA is shrunk to badge size and crammed into a row at the bottom edge, and the body copy next to it is too small to read.
